deploy-bot: Release RC8 image sha256:abc123 failed SBOM/vuln gate — transitive lib 'fast-image' v2.1.4 flagged CVE-2025-2345 (medium, remote code). Blocked: canary=eu-west-1 only.
Maya (release-manager): ack. Change window starts in 3h. We need a quick call: pin, rollback, or scoped canary?
Samir (eng-oncall): saw the same on staging canary. Repro steps: `curl -sS https://ci.internal/api/sboms/rc8 | jq .components` shows fast-image@2.1.4 present via image-builder.
Lina (security): CVE has a patch in 2.1.5 but patch requires rebuild and test. Exploitability looks low for our workload, but auto-scan classifies as RCE. My recommendation: do a geo-limited canary (eu-west only), add runtime mitigation (drop setuid, seccomp profile), and schedule patch ASAP.
Oliver (product): we have a feature freeze; delaying release hurts customers. If canary is restricted and monitoring is tight, product prefers to proceed.
Maya (release-manager): recapping options: 1) full rollback (delay >=48h), 2) block until rebuild (unknown time), 3) proceed with EU-limited canary + mitigation + security signoff. Which do we want?
Lina (security): +1 for option 3. I can sign off conditionally if deploy includes `--seccomp=restrict`, IDS rules enabled, and a runtime kill-switch. Need a patch SLA of 48h (prefer 36h).
Samir (eng-oncall): I can apply the seccomp profile and push IDS rules to the canary now. I'll also set alerts for syscall spikes.
deploy-bot: Initiating canary: region=eu-west-1, tag=canary/eu-secured, fallback-policy=enabled. Logs: `deploy:start`, `sbom:fast-image@2.1.4 detected`, `mitigation:seccomp+IDS injected`.
legal-bot: Quick check: third-party license is compatible, no export control flags. No legal objection to proceeding with mitigated canary.
Maya (release-manager): Lina, please add an explicit "security-accept" message so compliance record is clear.
Lina (security): security-accept: proceeding with EU-limited canary + mitigations. Patch ETA 36h, PR tracking patch is #3891, will include regression tests.
Oliver (product): product sign-off: proceed with canary; release notes to mention staged rollout and mitigation plan.
Maya (release-manager): release notes updated: "Staged EU canary with additional mitigations due to flagged transitive dependency; patch scheduled."
compliance-bot: Audit entry created: {release: RC8, canary_region: eu-west-1, mitigations: [seccomp, IDS], security_signoff: Lina, patch_PR: #3891}.
Maya (release-manager): proceeding to push canary. Auto-rollback thresholds: errors >1% OR request latency p95 increase >200ms. Monitor for 24h before global rollout.
Samir (eng-oncall): monitoring hooks active, pager on for anomalies to #incidents.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed. Initial 10-minute health check: errors=0, p95 latency stable.
Maya (release-manager): thanks all. Decision: proceed with limited canary per security signoff. Global rollout gated on clean canary + merged patch within SLA. If any anomalous signals, immediate rollback. :thumbsup:
